test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

I __will be gone to buy__ a cupboard which will fit under the stairs.
solution:
The correct answer is** "am going to buy".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Here we will see the correct formation of the sentence:

__
 
• I *am going to buy*__ a cupboard which will fit under the stairs.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 

__
 
• 

 Here we will explain the sentence formation:​​​​​***am going to buy__*** signifies future tense.
 
• 
 
**__*Going to*__** is not a tense. It is a special structure that we use to talk about the future.
